title: Ritual: Sacred Blooms and the Viridian Wildwood
summary: Forbidden Rites only: take Sacred Blooms from Ritual rewards, bloom a cluster of maps with the Viridian Wildwood, collect Primal, Vivid and Wild Wisps inside, then clear the empowered map. Two or more Ritual Tablets add an altar and more Wisps.

budget.why: A Sacred Bloom is consumed on the map, two Ritual Tablets are slotted, and waystones are rolled for two totals (pack size, monster rarity).
budget.build_needs: Clears a map whose monsters Wisps made Magic, gave extra modifiers or made more rewarding; GGG calls them considerably more dangerous.

claim.note: Our reading of the setup against the budget scale; not measured.

build.why: GGG: Wisp-empowered enemies 'become considerably more dangerous', and how much depends on the Wisps you collect.

claim.note: Our reading of the cited facts against the build scale; not measured.

complexity.why: Choose favours at the altars, bloom a cluster of maps with a Sacred Bloom, follow the Wisp trails in the Wildwood before its time runs out, then clear the empowered map.

claim.note: Our reading of the strategy's own steps against the complexity scale; not measured.

durability.why_it_works: Sacred Blooms from Ritual bloom a cluster of maps with the Viridian Wildwood, and its Wisps empower the map's monsters and rewards.
breaks_when: The Forbidden Rites league ends (Sacred Blooms drop only there)
The Wildwood or Wisp rewards are changed

claim.note: Our reading of the cited mechanic. Whether it pays today is only what live prices show.

yields.why: A Ritual reward in Forbidden Rites; adds a Viridian Wildwood to a Map and all Maps connected to it. Use it or sell it on the Currency Exchange.
An exclusive Ritual drop; tribute not spent on favours can be offered toward it.

nodes.name: Breeding Season
nodes.effect: 15% increased Rare Monsters; Rare Monsters have 25% increased chance of Monster Modifiers

nodes.name: Ancient Inscriptions
nodes.effect: 8% increased effect of Explicit Modifiers on Tablets for each type of Tablet affecting Map area

claim.note: No master node targets Ritual or the Wildwood. Vivid Wisps add modifiers to Rare Monsters, so more rares (Breeding Season) give them more targets. Ancient Inscriptions counts types of Tablet, so two Ritual Tablets are one type and give 8%; a second tablet type adds another 8%. Our picks, not measured. T2 and T4 are free picks.

waystone.notes: Wisps empower the map's monsters, so more monsters (pack size) and more rares (monster rarity) give Primal and Vivid Wisps more targets.

claim.note: GGG: 'Primal Wisps can transform Normal Monsters into Magic Monsters, Vivid Wisps can add modifiers to Rare Monsters, and Wild Wisps increase the rarity of items dropped by monsters.' 0.5.0: Monster Rarity 'affects the chances of magic and rare monsters'. Our reading, not measured.

steps: Allocate Tempting Offers and the Increased Tribute nodes; Patient Devotion lets you defer a Sacred Bloom you cannot afford yet.
Set Hilda: Breeding Season and Ancient Inscriptions; T2 and T4 are free picks.
Slot two or more Ritual Tablets: since 0.5.5 that adds an extra altar if possible and increases the Wisps you collect in the Viridian Wildwood.
Take a Sacred Bloom from the Ritual rewards and apply it to an endgame map: the Wildwood is added to that map and every map connected to it.
In a bloomed map, enter the Wildwood and follow the Wisp trails before time runs out: Primal (Normal monsters become Magic), Vivid (modifiers on Rares), Wild (more item rarity).
Leave the Wildwood and clear the map: its monsters carry the Wisps you collected.
risks: Sacred Blooms can only be found in the Forbidden Rites league.
GGG: empowered monsters become considerably more dangerous in exchange for their improved rewards.
GGG teased a rarer fourth Wisp, the Sacred Wisp; what it does is not documented here.
The Wildwood timer, Wisp counts and returns are not documented or measured; the basket has no map-loot rows.
0.5.5 disabled the old Viridian Wildwood unique map.
